assets.prompt:
Create ONE production-ready 3D application icon for Blender, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. The supplied image is the exact identity/reference from the installed real application; preserve its front-face logo, geometry, colors, spelling and proportions faithfully. Preserve the exact orange Blender glyph silhouette with its three orange arms, white inner ring and blue circular center. Extrude the actual silhouette itself as a solid chunky orange model; no square badge behind it.
 Art direction: a substantial, thick extruded physical model, not a flat illustration or a thin sticker. Extrusion depth approximately 22% of overall icon width, clearly visible on the right and lower sides. Front face nearly frontal, camera only 12 degrees above and 15 degrees to the left, so logo remains instantly recognizable and readable at 64 pixels. Smooth rounded bevels, rich soft enamel/plastic material, restrained polished specular highlights, convincing ambient occlusion around raised logo features. Adobe and Fusion front glyphs slightly raised above their original face with faithful edges. Key light upper left, gentle fill right. One centered model, all of it visible, occupying roughly 72% of a square canvas with generous transparent safe margin on every side. Thick sides use darker versions of the actual brand colors. No new symbols, no generic glyph, no separate pedestal, no background, no ground plane, no text captions, no added lettering, no extra props. Matching premium UI icon set for Neotrix Prism.
